message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerability was confirmed to affect the normalized DLL/component inventory during this 24-hour window.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only, normalized and deduplicated. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-16 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-17 07:40 UTC (2026-10-16 13:10 IST through 2026-10-17 13:10 IST).

### Findings

No confirmed relevant findings.

Recent reports reviewed in the window concerned other products and were excluded after product matching. GitHub's newest reviewed NuGet advisories were dated October 7, while its October 16 npm entry affected an unrelated package. Sources: [GitHub Advisory Database - NuGet](https://github.com/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Anuget&sort=published-desc), [GitHub Advisory Database - npm](https://github.com/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Anpm&sort=published-desc).

### Possible matches needing review

None.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported within this run's window. The newest entries visible in MongoDB's authoritative alert feed were dated October 13, outside the window. Source: [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts).

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability review is indicated from this scan. Continue routine monitoring; reassess any item if a vendor later publishes evidence tying it to a listed component or version.
